built: Yes (cover built; it already comes first)
rule: The first $10 of rewards each calendar month covers the card. It comes out of the full-value rewards first, before the use-or-save choice. It resets on the 1st and never rolls over; a month with less than $10 of rewards simply covers less. Active staff are exempt while your staff switch is on.
title: How the cover works
words: Free to get your card. Your first $10 of rewards each month covers it, so you never pay anything out of pocket.
